reason: Strider's ExpectationFailed doesn't attach the accessibility subtree of an element a containment matcher checked (toHaveText, toContainText) that matched; its nearest snapshot is set only when the locator matches nothing

Strider's ExpectationFailed doesn't attach a snapshot of the element a property matcher (toBeChecked, toHaveAttribute, toHaveRole, toHaveValue, toHaveCSS) checked, so there is no element line or clipped subtree to read

Strider's nearest snapshot is set only for a chain whose earlier step matched, so a single-step locator that matches nothing gets no page snapshot, and a page's title failure (toHaveTitle) carries no snapshot at all

These check that a failed toHaveCount, toHaveText with an array, or toMatchAriaSnapshot attaches no aria snapshot, as a control for the matchers that do (EX-313 to EX-323). Strider's ExpectationFailed attaches no matcher snapshot of a matched element, so asserting that `nearest` is none would hold for every matcher, with or without the feature
